purpose: Require vegetation ecology and tree-to-ground root-zone interfaces in every formal Unity 4K/temporal candidate after the detailed-tree rebuild, so the Vegetation/Natural Complexity gate cannot be evaluated from a candidate that silently dropped the contextual vegetation pass.

tree_pit_interface.intent: Replace a simplistic tree-ground intersection with a physically legible recessed soil basin, paving-edge construction and species/context-sensitive root transition while preserving the existing ground datum.

interfaces: tree trunk/root flare to soil basin
soil basin to paving edging on paved trees
soil basin to grass fringe on grass tree
understory/shrub/curb weeds to their supporting ground surfaces
construction_reasoning.orientation_and_exposure: All ecology placement remains scene-context driven relative to the existing six benchmark tree slots, curb/grass/plaza context and midsummer environment.

soil.weathering_rule: No wetness or dark runoff may be introduced without a causal exposure/drainage condition.

material_reasoning.angular_response: Dielectric soil/concrete and thin-leaf vegetation must derive grazing response from their PBR/shader models; painted or baked highlight bands are forbidden.

rules: Tree-pit dirt/soil variation must originate at the recessed basin/contact zone.
Paving-edge discoloration or accumulation may follow drainage/contact geometry but may not be placed as decorative random stains.
Vegetation density and ground contact must remain compatible with exposure and supporting surface type.

lod_and_temporal_policy.root_zone_note: Root-zone interface geometry is formal-scene evidence and must remain visually stable through benchmark camera motion; actual pop/shimmer judgement is render-only.

fail_closed_rules: FAIL if VegetationEcologyDetail is absent after the formal foliage rebuild.
FAIL if the ecology contract is not validated before ecology construction.
FAIL if the root-zone interface validator does not pass in the same formal scene candidate.
FAIL if legacy/simple tree-pit geometry remains where the root-zone reconstruction is required.
FAIL if required reconstructed counts, basin dimensions, paved/grass split, materials or contact metadata drift outside their contracts.
FAIL if formal validation can pass after deleting the ecology root or a required root-zone reconstruction.
FAIL if construction/material metadata is missing.
Do not self-repair after evidence capture has been armed; rebuild before the formal evidence epoch instead.

required_stills: 3840x2160 frontal/hero where vegetation interfaces are visible
render_verification.required_temporal: camera motion crossing relevant vegetation/tree LOD ranges

implementation_readiness.reason_not_higher: Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime, formal pass execution, failure injection and actual 4K evidence are not currently available from a Runner.
